law_hypotheses: L01 Provenance cannot be recovered from equal outputs alone.
L02 Authority cannot be promoted by computational success.
L03 A recovery never erases its failed witness.
L04 Canonical custody and compute location are independent variables.
L05 Every cross-boundary effect requires a content and context binding.
L06 Unknown state must remain unknown after projection.
L07 Reversibility decreases as external effects and audiences increase.
L08 Expired evidence cannot silently authorize a current effect.
L09 Identity labels do not prove continuity or agency.
L10 Privacy minimization is part of correctness, not post-processing.
L11 Equivalent numeric results may carry unequal ethical dispositions.
L12 A scheduler projection is not an activation.
L13 Local and cloud privilege must be evaluated at the actual process boundary.
L14 Cost ceilings are admission constraints, not target expenditures.
L15 Synthetic model success cannot close an empirical or affected-party gate.
open_problem_probes: O01 How can a capsule prove complete dependency closure without exporting secrets?
O02 How should reproducibility be scored when cloud images drift?
O03 What minimal receipt distinguishes retry from duplicate effect?
O04 How can a weighted roster remain legible when identities recur in different environments?
O05 What evidence is sufficient to promote a draft environment configuration?
O06 How can content-addressed imports preserve correction history?
O07 What is the smallest authority model that prevents numerical-result promotion?
O08 How can local private paths be removed without breaking reproducibility?
O09 How should a cloud result be quarantined before Git admission?
O10 Which failures should block all imports versus only one artifact?
O11 How can accessibility checks remain valid across static and interactive summaries?
O12 How should cost, carbon and latency trade-offs be represented without false precision?
O13 Can a formal state machine prevent early roster contact under retries?
O14 How can GMUT analogies be mechanically separated from empirical claims?
O15 What independent review would be needed before any production or Stage 20 claim?
